name: Elon Mosaic
spoken: I outbid Grant anonymously for a work he wanted. He blacklisted me from another acquisition and planned to block my museum board appointment. Tonight he was going to call my collecting speculative theater. It was an expensive grudge, even by his standards. During setup I borrowed the cabinet key and took the toxin sample. At 6:48, I used the excuse of discussing the board appointment to enter the salon. I dampened my gold-seamed linen with the sample and wiped the inside of Grant’s coupe and its rim. That transferred the poison. I left with the cloth. The door entry, key loan and linen receipt were all real. What I left out was what I did between them.

name: Anya Tique
spoken: I accepted the 1989 gift before its export papers arrived. I convinced myself the paperwork would follow. That failure should have been corrected years ago. My recorded salon visit ended before 6:40 and I did not return. The coupe was still clean at 6:40; I was not inside during the poisoning window. I had something to hide, but I did not murder Grant Larceny.

name: Artie Ficial
spoken: I accepted an offer from a rival museum. I was protecting my next job, not plotting a murder. My recorded salon visit ended before 6:40 and I did not return. The coupe was still clean at 6:40; I was not inside during the poisoning window. I had something to hide, but I did not murder Grant Larceny.
